description:
Partner with Guerilla Choice, a US jewelry brand offering more than 1,000 designs across solid gold, diamonds, moissanite, sterling silver, stainless steel, pearls, tennis jewelry, personalized pieces and customized designs. Our collection ranges from elevated everyday essentials and meaningful gifts to high-ticket fine jewelry and customizable designs.

WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT

We collaborate with award winning designers from around the world, and many of our high value pieces are finished by hand. We can bring virtually any custom jewelry idea to life, from a personal modification to a completely original design created just for you. With a large team across the USA and Barcelona, we combine international design expertise, skilled craftsmanship and personal service.

HOW AFFILIATES CAN EARN

Partners can earn up to 15% commission on eligible sales through a personalized affiliate link or creator coupon. Our wide price range, including high value gold and diamond pieces, offers meaningful earning potential with every successful referral.

Affiliates also benefit from a 60-day tracking cookie, monthly payouts, ready to use content and additional rewards for strong performance.

HOW TO PROMOTE US

You know your audience better than anyone, so we will not ask you to follow a specific format or create a particular type of content. You are free to promote Guerilla Choice in the way that feels most natural, authentic and effective for you.

OUR PARTNERSHIP

We want to build long-term relationships with creators and affiliates who genuinely connect with our brand. As Guerilla Choice grows, our best-performing partners can receive additional rewards, exclusive campaigns, free products and increased earning opportunities.

If we win, you win too that is the kind of partnership we believe in.
payout_period: Commissions are validated after a 30-day review period and paid monthly between the 1st and 5th, once the $50 minimum payout is reached. Payments are available via PayPal or bank transfer.
